How Travel Partner works

From first hello to the same trip, in five steps

1

Create a verified profile

Add your photo, travel style and trips. Verify phone, government ID and a selfie (18+ only).

2

Search your way

By destination, month, package, interest, city or women-only — with a match score.

3

Match & chat safely

Contact details stay hidden. Chat opens only after both accept.

4

Plan & book together

Pick a package, choose seats together, and decide shared or separate rooms.

5

Pay your way

Pay for both, split 50/50, or book individually. Travel with 24×7 support.

Trust & verification

Every profile is checked by a real person

Photos help you recognise each other; ID proof keeps the community genuine. Your documents are for verification only — never shown to other members.

Verify my profile
  1. Mobile OTP

    Confirms your number (kept private).

  2. Government ID

    Aadhaar (masked), PAN, passport, driving licence or voter ID — we see only the last 4 digits.

  3. Selfie match

    A live selfie is matched to your ID photo by our team.

  4. Profile photo

    Shown to members — or only after you accept a request, your choice.

  5. Documents deleted

    ID images are deleted once your profile is approved or rejected.

Book together, your way

Every option works on every TripPartner package

Pay options

  • One pays for both — you or your partner books for two
  • Split 50/50 — two payment links, one booking
  • Book individually — separate bookings on the same departure

Seats together

  • Adjacent seats on flights, trains and buses (subject to availability)
  • Same cab or coach for all transfers and sightseeing
  • Same itinerary, same guide, same timings

Stay: shared or separate

  • Shared room only when both travellers agree
  • Separate rooms any time, with single-room supplement
  • Switch from shared to separate until final payment
Safety centre

Safety comes first, for every traveller

We built Travel Partner with women travellers in mind. These rules apply to every member and every trip.

Read safety guidelines
18+ and ID-verified

Government ID and phone verification before a profile goes live.

Mutual consent

Requests, chats, shared rooms and bookings need both travellers to agree.

Private contact details

Numbers and emails stay hidden until you choose to share them.

24×7 SOS support

One-tap help line during the trip, with live trip tracking by our team.

Women-only filter

Women can choose to be visible to, and match with, women only.

Report & block

Block anyone instantly. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

Travel Partner FAQs

Who can use Travel Partner?

Adults aged 18 and above with a verified phone number and government ID. Profiles that fail verification are not shown.

Is my phone number visible to others?

No. Your phone, email and full name stay hidden. Chat opens only after both travellers accept a request, and you can block or report anyone at any time.

Do we have to share a room?

No. Separate rooms are always available. A shared room is booked only when both travellers agree, and either of you can switch to separate rooms before the final payment.

Can one person pay for both?

Yes. One traveller can pay for both, you can split the cost 50/50 with two payment links, or each of you can book individually on the same departure.

Will we sit together?

We request adjacent seats on flights, trains and buses. Airline and railway seat allocation is subject to availability, and paid seat selection may apply.

What if my partner cancels?

Each traveller's booking follows our cancellation policy. If your partner cancels a shared-room booking, you can continue with a single-room supplement or change your plans.

Is this a dating service?

No. Travel Partner helps adults find compatible travel companions. Respectful behaviour is mandatory and any misuse leads to removal.

Why do you ask for a photo and ID proof?

A clear photo helps travellers recognise each other, and a government ID with a selfie match keeps fake profiles out. Both are checked by our team before a profile goes live.

Who can see my ID document?

Only TripPartner's verification team. Other members never see it — they only see an "ID verified" badge. ID images are deleted once your profile is approved or rejected; we keep only the ID type and last 4 digits.

Can I hide my photo?

Yes. You can show your photo to all verified members, only after you accept a request, or (for women) only to women. Until then others see your initials.

Which IDs are accepted?

Masked Aadhaar, PAN card, passport, driving licence or voter ID. For Aadhaar, please upload the masked version that hides the first 8 digits.
